note: BH-6876: the per-shard budget in seconds of suite time (no job setup). bin/ci-plan-settings.sh projects it into the repo variable CI_SHARD_BUDGET_S, and bin/ci-plan.sh uses the fewest shards whose slowest one is within it, by the weights of bin/ci-durations.sh fetch. A suite longer than the budget is said as `over budget` on the plan's sizing line. A whole number in 60..3600; anything else is refused (warn alert ci-plan-settings-sizing:<slug>). Lower = more shards and more setup minutes. The code fallback with no variable is 480.
